name: universal-issue-analysis
description: Universal Issue Analysis — a readout-first, agency-and-rights-aware protocol for turning any reported issue into a finite, auditable analysis. Loads before analyzing an incident, complaint, conflict, risk, or decision request: mandatory two-question intake gate, retained-difference issue framing, stakeholder/agency mapping, global/local evidence-challenged hypotheses, and a three-lane candidate portfolio with rights and diversity gates.
